text:
Riley M.: AuroraEdge bench sync: were coordinating a joint perf/W and sustained throughput sweep on their marketplace board. Goal: clear, repeatable numbers for the datasheet and marketplace listing. Proposed slot Fri 09:00 PT.
Kai Zhou: I'll own the telemetry pipeline. What models/datasets and guardrails?
Riley M.: Lock to redwood-mini-suite-v2 and aurora-open-7b-q4i. Use redwood-microbench-v3 inputs. KV cache off, deterministic seeds. Batch sizes 1,8,32. Target throughput band 1700-2100 toks/s steady state. Perf/W primary metric.
Sophie L.: For kernel optimizations: supply them as a user-space shim and a kernel module tarball placed in /opt/aurora/plugins so no rebuild needed. We'll include apply/rollback scripts and a signed SBOM. Need partner security scan before we run public numbers.
BenchBot: Lab slot reserved: aurora-edge-1 Fri 09:00-13:00 PT for `aurora_marketplace_bench`. Use `@BenchBot extend aurora-edge-1 1h` to extend.
Kai Zhou: Telemetry plan: 1s cadence JSONL to telemetry-ingest with fields (ts, run_id, model, batch, seq_len, tokens, latency_ms, gpu_watts, pdu_watts). I'll post schema and sample by Wed EOD. Will also add a minimal ingestion CLI for Aurora to test.
CommsBot: Partner requested co-listing on marketplace; they'll wait for our validation. Recommend internal embargo 48h post-run for verification and legal. Share quotes early so legal can pre-clear.
Riley M.: Run command to standardize with partner:
```bash
./aurora_bench --suite redwood-mini-suite-v2 \
  --models aurora-open-7b-q4i,redwood-mpt-7b-q4 \
  --seq 2048 --batches 1,8,32 \
  --metrics throughput,latency,perf_per_watt \
  --trace kernel:hotspots --out traces/aurora_friday
```
Sophie L.: Add perf/W abort rule: if perf/W drops >6% vs baseline/aurora-ref then abort and upload kernel traces to /artifacts/aurora/aborts. Also include a smoke step that verifies seccomp + module apply.
Kai Zhou: Noted. I'll open the telemetry PR and include CI checks that validate schema and sample payload by Wed EOD.
Riley M.: Action items recap: Kai -> telemetry schema + CLI; Sophie -> module tarball + apply/rollback + SBOM; Comms -> draft marketplace listing + embargo handling; Riley -> runbook + bench automation and baseline tag. Dry-run Thurs 16:00 PT. Thanks all. :rocket:
